scope: Browser Force telekinesis for people and 15 existing street bins

controls.pointer: Select a visible nearby person or bin while Force mode is enabled

implementation: Damped lift and lowering, mass-dependent push impulse, gravity and drag, collision substeps up to 1/120 second.
Rendered paving support under a sampled footprint; collision checks against buildings, street furniture, trees, other bodies, visitor and carriage.
Walking routes pause during holds and replan from landing positions. Indoor people lift in place and their work clocks pause.
Moved bins participate in visitor collision and pedestrian passing. Force elevation participates in conversation reach.
Free-hand casting gesture layers over Three.js locomotion; conflicting wishes are blocked.

validation.build: pass; existing large Three.js chunk warning

A real pointer click targets the person in Force mode
Force picking does not open a conversation
G acquires the selected person
The rendered person rises, not just the state
Force hold suspends pedestrian navigation
X gently lands and releases the person
Released person resumes walking
A Force push displaces a person and lands them
An existing street bin can be targeted through normal travel
The complete bin rises with its lid
R pushes a real object and it settles at its new position
Indoor stations lift in place without crossing work surfaces
A levitated worker pauses their task
Escape lowers the worker and their task resumes
Force mode can be disabled
No uncaught browser errors
force-lift has a 44px touch target

Force controls fit the phone viewport
No uncaught phone errors
